_comment: TIMELINE CONTENT — professional chapters only. This file drives the timeline cards, the journey map markers, and the progression path. Personal-life chapters live in the private companion site (~/workspace/portfolio-private/), never here. To add a professional chapter, append an object. To swap a placeholder illustration for a real photo later, set "photo" to a path like "assets/photos/my-photo.jpg" — the card renderer picks it up automatically, no code changes needed.
_photo_howto: Place photos in assets/photos/ (web-friendly: .jpg/.webp, < 300KB each). Then set the chapter's "photo" field. Captions go in "photoCaption".
